34.64429,-84.39008: Cartecay Methodist Church. This church, Cartecay Methodist (South), was organized and a building erected in August 1834 on the property of Lewis D. Ellington. The first preacher was William Ellington, ordained in 1805 by Bishop Asbury. The first Sunday School was organized April 20, 1851 and has operated continuously. The present building, erected in 1859, remains, in style and arrangement, as originally built. During the War Between the States, the building was guarded at night by groups of men to protect it from Union sympathizers who roamed the country-side. Among the early preachers were: Rev. Bethel Quillian, Rev. John B. Robeson, Rev. A.J. Hughes, Rev. A.J. Hutchinson, Rev. A.D. Echols, Rev. Walter B. Dillard, Rev. R.B.O. England, Rev. G.W. Griner, Rev. W.L. Singleton, Rev. J.N. Myers, Rev. W.C. Hunnicut, Rev. John B. Pettit. As a young man Bishop Warren Candler preached here. 061-5 GEORGIA HISTORICAL COMMISSION 1957
